commitResults.messageBody: Rename Duke to Sace, add the greeting and exit output and update the documentation.
Read user input until bye and echo each non-exit command.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Level 2 task storage and listing
commitResults.messageBody: Store up to 100 tasks in memory, acknowledge additions, and display numbered tasks with the list command.
Represent tasks as objects and support mark and unmark commands with completion status icons.
Support todos, deadlines, and events using inheritance and parse their type-specific command details.
Validate commands, task details, and indexes with a custom exception so invalid input produces helpful messages without terminating the chatbot.
Store tasks in an ArrayList and support validated deletion with automatic task renumbering.
